results.description:
When a faculty reception at Northport College ends with a prominent professor’s sudden death, Elise St. James never expects to become involved in the investigation. But as the college’s director of communications—and a firsthand witness to the evening’s events—she quickly realizes that what happened on campus that night was no accident.
As whispers spread across the tight-knit college community, Elise begins to notice details others overlook: a bitter divorce, simmering professional rivalries, ambitious students, a bartender with secrets, and a drink that may have held more than good cheer.
But asking questions on a small campus can be dangerous. As the truth edges closer, Elise must decide how far she’s willing to go for answers—before someone decides she knows too much.
An Old Fashioned Murder is a cozy mystery filled with academic intrigue, sharp dialogue, loyal friendships, and just a hint of romance—perfect for readers who enjoy smart sleuths, charming settings, and puzzles best solved with a cocktail in hand.
